name: select-native
title: Native Select
description: A shipping form of three plain dropdown controls: Country and Delivery speed are single-line boxes with a chevron, while Extras is an open list box of four selectable rows.
use: A simple form choice needs native keyboard and mobile behaviour without building a custom popup.
avoid: Native lists render differently on each browser and platform, so the look is only partly controllable.
a11y: Native semantics give full keyboard and screen-reader support; the only gap is that the popup's look varies by platform. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card titled 'Shipping details' with three stacked fields. Country and Delivery speed are single-line boxes ending in a small chevron, the second holding grey placeholder text; Extras is an open dark list of four option rows, the first highlighted.
behaves: Clicking a single-line box opens the browser's own option list and the chosen name replaces the text. The Extras box stays open as a list, where clicking a row toggles its highlight, and any focused box gets a brighter border.
customise: Options are children; adding the multiple attribute switches to list-box layout, and everything else is a class override on the native control.
weight: light: A native control with a decorative chevron; no script or animation.
demo: Countries US, Germany, India and Japan; standard or express delivery; extras like gift wrapping and insurance.
issues: The open Extras list box takes four rows and dominates the otherwise compact card
The disabled first delivery option looks like a grey placeholder and could be read as a value
polishWhy: Clean minimal form; the always-open multi-choice box takes over the card.
